results.title: Parents Urged to Restrict Grand Theft Auto 6 Access for Minors Under 17
results.description: ABC parenting reporter Bethany Bron Silva advises parents against allowing children under 17 to play Grand Theft Auto 6 due to its graphic content and lack of developmental benefits for minors.

results.title: Six Literary Classics Ranked Higher Than Harry Potter Series
results.description: An analysis of six timeless children's books, including The Little Prince and Charlotte's Web, which experts argue surpass the Harry Potter franchise in depth and lasting impact.
